claims.method: Exact FastJet 3.4.3 E-scheme inclusive reclustering, with pp CA/kT/anti-kT or finite-radius ee generalized kT. Enumerates every diagonal once and every unordered off-diagonal twice, using original scalar-pt/energy denominators, post-clustering kappa weights, massive four-vectors, and explicit flow bins. Histograms are averaged over the supplied number of jets.
claims.limitations: Double-precision floating-point roundoff at exactly degenerate clustering or bin boundaries; no sampling or multiplicity cuts.
